name: Majo Ijime
source:
This is a short, trashy comedy visual novel that takes just 3 minutes to finish.
It’s a slightly lewd and trashy story where Neko-chan becomes a witch after The Witch's Execution Day and visits Zaijoin-san’s house. It’s technically a comedy.
Zaijoin-san has a bit of an irritating, mean-spirited vibe.
